Desperate Flight' booklet. American dime novels in a polybag: 'New Nick Carter Weekly' (Street & Smith) dated Jan 16 1909, 5 cents, number reads about 625 (digits not certain), and 'Frank Merriwell's Own, Tip Top Weekly'. Also 'New Buffalo Bill Library' No. 161 'The Haunted Ranch' (1d), 'Romance' No. 252 'My Lady May' (1d weekly), Cassell's 'New Penny Magazine' No. 4 (about 1913), 'Collins' Penny Library: Audrey Marsh', a Cadbury's Cocoa 'The Penny Library of Famous Books' booklet, an 'Answers' novel 'The Silvermedal...', 'Dick T...' (probably a Dick Turpin title), 'Tearl's Venture' and an orange booklet headed 'Snor...'.
